title: The Live Border
author: Yara Okafor
blurb: Yara Ishikawa, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
